title: Texas Works Handbook, C-110 TANF: C-111 Income Limits (TANF budgetary allowances, effective Oct. 1, 2026), C-112 How to Prorate TANF Grants, C-112.1 Proration Multiplier Chart
as_at: C-111 Revision 26-4, effective 2026-10-01; C-112 Revision 22-3, effective 2022-07-01; C-112.1 Revision 01-7, effective 2001-10-01
what_it_sets: TANF budgetary needs, recognizable needs (25%) and maximum grant by family size 1-15 (+ each additional person) for non-caretaker cases, caretaker cases without a second parent, and caretaker cases with a second parent; first-month proration multipliers; no grant if prorated amount under $10.
read_on_register_not_deposited: e.g. caretaker case without second parent: family of 1 $162, 2 $336, 3 $388, 4 $466 maximum grant; each additional person $89.
